entry.title: PotentialPunch 1.0.2
entry.summary: - Fixed: pressing **STOP** or **Overdub** while the MPC was playing could reload the preset and undo your ATTACK / SUSTAIN / MIX tweaks. The MPC's host briefly changes a plugin's first parameter when it re-prepares audio, and that was PRESET. That first slot now does nothing; PRESET is a new parameter at the end (same menu, same Q-Link). Saved projects open with their preset and settings as before.

entry.title: PotentialPunch 1.0.1
entry.summary: **PotentialPunch 1.0.1**: bug fix. - **Fixed:** the MPC's **PRESET** menu kept closing (and its list flickered) while PotentialPunch was open. The live meter no longer makes the MPC redraw its screen, so the menu stays open. - The line above the meter is now a short tip instead of live numbers; the meter still shows the boost or cut as it happens. entry.title: PotentialPunch 1.0.0
entry.summary: **PotentialPunch 1.0.0**, the first release. A transient shaper for your MPC: more or less punch at the start of every hit, and more or less tail after it, with no threshold to set. 12 one-tap presets for drums, breaks and more. See the [README](https://github.com/PotentialBreakfast/mpc-vst-potentialpunch#readme) for everything it does and its limitations. **Download** `PotentialPunch-1.0.0-mpc-armv7.zip` below. It's for Gen1 (32-bit) MPCs on MPC OS 3.x and has been tested on an MPC One. Install
